messages:
tara: ok team — sync on the PRD for the API variant-slicing approach. we need a concise acceptance checklist for chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank before we lock scope by EOW. who can take the lead on each?
jamal: i can own chat/completions. thinking slices: basic (single-turn), convo-state (KV cache), streaming. acceptance: latency SLOs, streaming gaps < 200ms, token-cost budget.
alex: i'll take embeddings. slices: small (512d), medium (1536d), dense-quant (8-bit). acceptance: recall thresholds per slice (> 0.88 for medium), vector-size clear in API, backward-compatible embedding id.
ben: rerank owner. slices: score-only sync, score+explain (structured reasons), fallback to model-A when under-provision. acceptance: pairwise A/B improvement >= 5% on our benchmark, deterministic tie-breaker, latency p95 under 120ms for score-only.
cindy: quick product constraints: customers asked for per-request slice override and a service-level rollout plan with canary by customer segment. add "customer-level pin" to API contract.
tara: +1 on customer pin. note: we must avoid exploding token pricing complexity — keep pricing mapping 1:1 with slice family not per-variant.
jamal: edge cases i want listed in PRD: 1) truncated KV on resume, 2) mismatch when client provides older model version in conversation metadata, 3) streaming disconnects mid-output -> automatic regenerate tail.
alex: embeddings edge cases: 1) dimensionality mismatch during upsert, 2) quantized vs float storage read path, 3) partial reindex signals for cold-start customers.
ben: rerank edge cases: 1) score ties across different model variants (we need stable ordering), 2) incompatible feature vectors (fall back to lexical scoring), 3) overloaded GPU -> degrade to CPU endpoint and tag trace.
tara: launch criteria draft (high level): - Core acceptance pass on each slice - End-to-end smoke tests for common clients - Canary to 5% of traffic with roll-back policy - Telemetry: tokens, p95 latency, rerank delta, quality regressions flagged via eval set
cindy: also add security/compliance check: no PII persisted in embeddings by default; opt-in customer storage only and KMS for private.
jamal: small API proposal snippet: 
```
POST /v1/responses
body: { model: "redwood-chat-v1", slice: "convo-state", client_pin: "team-123", input: "..." }
```
response: streaming chunks with `cursor` for resume.
ben: for rerank API example: 
```
POST /v1/rerank
body: { model: "rerank-v2", slice: "score-only", items: [{id:"a", doc:"..."}, ...], trace_id: "xyz" }
```
response: [ {id: "a", score: 0.72, reason: null} ]

tara: let's keep `reason` nullable to avoid cost on default path. `explain` slice toggles non-null reasons.
alex: acceptance criteria specifics for embeddings: add regression alert if mean cosine drop > 0.03 vs baseline on nightly eval. also: API should return `embedding_dim` in response metadata for client validation.
cindy: rollout plan: week 1 internal + partners canary, week 2 open to self-serve with default throttles, week 3 full open with reserved capacity for enterprise. SLA gating for Dedicated customers only after 4 weeks.
jamal: test matrix items I'll add to PRD: - smoke (basic prompt) - convo state resume (5-step) - streaming reconnect - cold KV cache hit-rate metrics - cost per 1k tokens by slice
ben: rerank test matrix: - deterministic tie breaker property - throughput test at 2k QPS for score-only slice - failure injection to ensure fallback path triggers and is observable in traces
tara: ok action items: jamal write chat slice acceptance + sample tests by Tue, alex write embeddings acceptance + eval thresholds by Tue, ben write rerank acceptance + benchmark plan by Wed. cindy assemble rollout + pricing note. i'll collate into PRD and ping design for API contract doc.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window 2025-03-05 02:00 UTC (holds until PRD approved) :warning:
cindy: pinging here — we should add a short section on customer opt-in for explainability reasons (legal/regulatory). make it explicit in acceptance and UI notes.
tara: agreed. also add observability: per-request `slice` tag + sampling for full reasons. otherwise we can't debug explain costs.
jamal: i'll add logs + trace spans to spec. will include sample `span.slice: convo-state` and `span.kv_hit:true/false`.
alex: FYI — embeddings storage ops: plan to index asynchronously for dense-quant; add acceptance note that query-time latency for medium slice must not exceed 40ms p95 after indexing.
tara: great. let's keep this tight. i'll update the PRD draft tonight and share link here. if you can't meet the Tue/Wed items call it out now.
ben: all good, except i need access to latest rerank test harness — @cindy can you grant?
cindy: done, invited you to the repo.
tara: thanks everyone. next check-in Friday standup. :thumbsup:
